hook: The most generous player in hockey history is also the best one.
story: Wayne Gretzky, the Canadian they call The Great One, won four Stanley Cups with the 1980s Edmonton Oilers. In hockey, a point is a goal you score, or an assist: a goal you hand to a teammate. Gretzky retired in 1999 with 894 goals and 1,963 assists. Second place in the entire history of the sport, Jaromir Jagr, has 1,921 - goals and assists combined.
number: So here is the generosity: delete all 894 of Gretzky's own goals, and the ones he handed to teammates still outnumber everyone's everything. He also owns the only four 200-point seasons ever played, and retired holding 61 NHL records.
closer: No one has worn his number, 99, in the league since. No one ever will.

In hockey, a point is a goal you score, or an assist: a goal you hand to a teammate. Gretzky retired in 1999 with 894 goals and 1,963 assists. Second place in the entire history of the sport, Jaromir Jagr, has 1,921 - goals and assists combined. So here is the generosity: delete all 894 of Gretzky's own goals, and the ones he handed to teammates still outnumber everyone's everything. He also owns the only four 200-point seasons ever played, and retired holding 61 NHL records. No one has worn his number, 99, in the league since. No one ever will.
